name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-04-07, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
